scope: Remaining release-manifest capability, visibility, and parallel smoke callers
implementation: Capabilities smoke retains root/child registry, cache, observational show, doctor, and validation scenarios under owned fixture and supervised Node execution.
Visibility smoke packs through private npm state, admits the candidate before installation, verifies exact bytes after exercise, and retains archive/pack/subgraph visibility refusal scenarios.

Parallel smoke retains 32 SQLite and 16 JSON concurrent creation, checkpoint, reference update, index, and validation scenarios inside one supervised worker; it now removes the owned root only after child closure.

The parallel internal worker refuses direct invocation and requires the supervised context plus an exact per-run owner token stored in a single-link regular file; focused controls verify refusal before graph writes.
All three command-line entrypoints emit machine-readable success and cleanup receipts while retaining their existing human-readable success text.
Release-manifest smoke entrypoint inventory no longer has raw spawnSync or mkdtempSync except the intentional hostile-Git shim text in smoke-git-boundary, already separately qualified.

review.scope: bounded read-only source review, not Task828 or Standard security acceptance
review.correction: The directly runnable parallel internal worker accepted another temporary root; supervised-context and owner-token admission plus a pre-write refusal regression were added.
review.qualification_limit: Visibility uses the immutable candidate only in the proxy-qualified release run. A standalone direct invocation without the proxy can execute package prepack against canonical source and is not covered by this no-repack claim.

remaining: The ignored private local candidate copy is retained for custody only. It is not a final sealed or shared Git artifact. Final release-wide validation, security acceptance, exact 0.6.0 artifact seal and required platform evidence are separate gates.
Historical blocked raw security context remains inaccessible by current user direction; no recovery or rerun was attempted.
superseded_attempts: First three-runtime passes had 100 affected checks before the independent reviewer identified direct internal-worker entry; the corrected 101-check reruns above supersede them.
authority: local Goal86 execution only; no stage, commit, push, remote, tag, publication, provider, deployment, bundle refresh or sibling action
